panels.title: Page views
panels.sql: SELECT count() AS value FROM events WHERE kind = 'page_view' AND ts >= :from AND ts < :to

panels.title: Sessions
panels.sql: SELECT uniqExact(session_id) AS value FROM events WHERE kind = 'page_view' AND ts >= :from AND ts < :to

panels.title: Contact requests
panels.sql: SELECT count() AS value FROM events WHERE kind = 'contact_form_sent' AND ts >= :from AND ts < :to

panels.title: Page views over time
panels.sql: SELECT bucket(ts, :bucket) AS time, count() AS views FROM events WHERE kind = 'page_view' AND ts >= :from AND ts < :to GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Page views by country
panels.sql: SELECT JSONExtractString(dimensions, 'country') AS country, count() AS views FROM events WHERE kind = 'page_view' AND ts >= :from AND ts < :to GROUP BY country ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 480

panels.title: Top pages
panels.sql: SELECT JSONExtractString(dimensions, 'path') AS path, count() AS views FROM events WHERE kind = 'page_view' AND ts >= :from AND ts < :to GROUP BY path ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Pages in detail
panels.sql: SELECT JSONExtractString(dimensions, 'path') AS path, countIf(kind = 'page_view') AS views, uniqExactIf(session_id, kind = 'page_view') AS sessions, countIf(kind = 'contact_form_sent') AS contacts FROM events WHERE ts >= :from AND ts < :to GROUP BY path ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 100
